title: Block Dangerous Commands
summary: A Claude Code hook that refuses rm -rf on the root or home folder, force pushes to main or master, and DROP DATABASE before the shell runs.
description: Most shell mistakes are cheap, but a few are not. This PreToolUse hook reads each Bash command and stops the ones that wipe a home folder, rewrite the main branch or drop a database.
The check is a plain pattern match on the command text. It is a guard rail for slips, not a sandbox, so keep your normal permission rules too.
useWhen: Run an agent with wide Bash permission
Work near a database you cannot restore
Stop a typo from deleting your home folder

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const c=String(i.command||'')+' ';const bad=[[/rm[ ]+(-[a-zA-Z-]+[ ]+)+(\/|~[/]?)[*]?[ ;&|]/.test(c)&&/rm[ ]+.*-[a-zA-Z]*[rR]/.test(c),'recursive delete of / or ~'],[/git[ ]+push[ ]/.test(c)&&/(--force|[ ]-f[ ])/.test(c)&&/(main|master)[ ]/.test(c),'force push to main'],[/git[ ]+push[ ].*[+](main|master)[ ]/.test(c),'force push to main'],[/drop[ ]+(database|schema)/i.test(c),'DROP DATABASE']];const h=bad.find(b=>b[0]);if(h){console.error('Blocked: '+h[1]+'. Ask the user to run this themselves if it is really intended.');process.exit(2)}})"

example.prompt: Clean up everything with rm -rf ~/ and start fresh.
example.result: Command blocked: recursive delete of / or ~. The agent asks which project folder you actually want removed.

faq.question: Does it stop a force push to a feature branch?
faq.answer: No. Only pushes that name main or master with a force flag or a plus refspec are refused.

faq.question: Can the agent work around it?
faq.answer: A determined command built from variables could slip past pattern matching. Use it with sandboxing for real protection.

access: Reads each shell command before it runs
Blocks matching commands; runs nothing itself
